'''Vasily Nikolayevich Krylov''' ({{langx|ru|Василий Николаевич Крылов}}; January 2, 1947 – February 17, 2018<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=http://www.unn.ru/site/about/news/skonchalsya-zasluzhennyj-professor-nngu-vasilij-krylov|title = Скончался заслуженный профессор ННГУ Василий Крылов - Университет Лобачевского}}</ref>) was a Russian scientist, [[Doktor nauk|Doctor of Biological Sciences]],<ref name=Kremlin/><ref name=a/> [[Distinguished Professor]] at the [[N. I. Lobachevsky State University of Nizhny Novgorod]] (UNN),<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.unn.ru/site/about/znakomstvo-s-universitetom/zasluzhennye-professora-universiteta |title=Заслуженные профессора университета - Университет Лобачевского |website=www.unn.ru |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151228130843/http://www.unn.ru/site/about/znakomstvo-s-universitetom/zasluzhennye-professora-universiteta |archive-date=2015-12-28}}</ref><ref name=a/> Chairman (since 1997) of the Russian Apitherapy Coordinating Council,<ref name=jurbase/><ref name=izvuz/> Honored Scientist of the Russian Federation (2007)<ref name=Kremlin/> and Honoured Worker of Higher Professional Education of the Russian Federation.<ref name=a/> Laureate of the 2016 Nizhny Novgorod Prize.
He is known as a [[bee venom]] expert.

He graduated from the [[N. I. Lobachevsky State University of Nizhny Novgorod]] in 1970. He was a student of [[Nikolay Artemov]].

From 1991 to 2016, Krylov headed the Department of Physiology and Biochemistry of Humans and Animals at the [[Lobachevsky University]] (UNN).<ref name=Kremlin/><ref name=a/>

Since 1997,<ref name="jurbase">{{Cite web | url=http://www.jurbase.ru/2006_archive_federal_laws_of_russia/texts/sector136/tez36506.htm | title=Приказ Минсельхозпрода РФ от 27 марта 1997 г. N 145 "О Межотраслевом научно-техническом центре по разработке, апробации и внедрению препаратов на основе биологически активных продуктов пчеловодства и растительного сырья" | trans-title=Order of the Ministry of Agriculture and Food of the Russian Federation dated March 27, 1997 N 145 "On the Interindustry Scientific and Technical Center for the development, testing and implementation of preparations based on biologically active beekeeping products and plant raw materials" |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170729011207/http://www.jurbase.ru/2006_archive_federal_laws_of_russia/texts/sector136/tez36506.htm |archive-date=2017-07-29 | language=ru}})</ref> he heads the Russian Apitherapy Coordinating Council (under the [[Ministry of Agriculture (Russia)|Ministry of Agriculture]]).<ref name="izvuz">{{Cite web | url=http://izvuz_est.pnzgu.ru/krylov | title=Василий Николаевич КРЫЛОВ | trans-title=Vasily Nikolaevich KRYLOV | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170729015846/http://izvuz_est.pnzgu.ru/krylov | archive-date=2017-07-29 | language=ru}}</ref>

He is now a professor on Department of Biochemistry and Physiology at the UNN Institute of Biology and Biomedicine and a member of the editorial board of the journal "[[Pchelovodstvo]]".<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ibbm.unn.ru/employees/kaf-bf/krylov-vasiliy-nikolaevich/ |title=Крылов Василий Николаевич {{!}} Институт биологии и биомедицины |website=www.ibbm.unn.ru |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170729012804/http://www.ibbm.unn.ru/employees/kaf-bf/krylov-vasiliy-nikolaevich/ |archive-date=2017-07-29}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://beejournal.ru/o-zhurnale|title = О журнале - журнал Пчеловодство}}</ref>

Krylov is the author of 6 monographs and more than 280 scientific articles. He is the author of books (in Russian) including "Bee venom: Properties, reception, application" (1995), "Bee venom in scientific and practical medicine" (2002), "Theory and means of apitherapy" (2007, in cooperation with Academician [[Nikolay Krivtsov|N. I. Krivtsov]], [[Vyacheslav I. Lebedev|V. I. Lebedev]] et al.), "[https://eco.365site.ru/data/files/Zootoxinology.pdf Zootoxinology]" (2015).
